object: label to figure F of procession I
site: Philae, Temple of Isis, the 'Meroitic Chamber'
notes: Published L., D., VI, Bl. 2, no. 7; photo no. 720. All 7 '?' are Griffith's. His notes: l. 1 'The honourable Mashtaraq'; l. 2 bedewi is perhaps the place-name Bezewe (see 89); p?Sdk is 'altered to or from' a form with m (or h) as first sign; l. 3 wiyleb is a plural; l. 4 ptl?teb is 'a genitive plural adjective, (things) of patal (?)'; l. 5 ptrq, cf. the name Mashtirq; the last group recurs elsewhere, 'but the ob looks more like r, an improbable initial'. Its third sign has the pointed h-form (X), checked at 2.5x against the m of mStrq and the X of XeN; FHN III reads m. Against the test's readings.md: type lines 1 and 2 agree (its '[e?]' in dxe is Griffith's printed '?'); type line 3 (stone ll. 4-6), which the test's crop missed, is new here.
